records.title: Polisario Front declares general mobilisation as UN Western Sahara mission winds down
records.summary: The Polisario Front declared a general mobilisation against Morocco on 10 November 2026 following the end of the UN peacekeeping mission's mandate in Western Sahara.

confirmed_facts.text: The Polisario Front's National Secretariat declared a state of general mobilisation on 10 November.

international_perspectives.text: A Morocco-based outlet dismissed the declaration as rhetoric and said it gave no details on locations, units or measures.

records.impact_assessment: Potential: renewed armed confrontation along the berm and further strain on Morocco–Algeria relations.
records.priority_rationale: MODERATE: a confirmed mobilisation announcement in a frozen conflict without observed escalation.
unknowns: Whether mobilisation translates into military action
monitoring_actions: Watch for reported clashes along the berm
Follow UN statements on MINURSO's withdrawal

update_history.summary: Published after editorial review by Marcel Dera.

records.observed_action: On 10 November 2026 the Polisario Front's National Secretariat declared a state of general mobilisation, citing Moroccan military movements, as the UN mission MINURSO is being withdrawn.
records.interpretation: A significant political signal after the end of the UN mission, but no clashes had been reported in the sources reviewed; it does not by itself establish imminent large-scale fighting.

records.title: US president signals decision on renewed Iran strikes after 1 January
records.summary: US statements on 19 and 22 November 2026 set the start of 2027 as a decision point on renewed US military action against Iran.

reported_claims.text: Trump said he would talk about possible new strikes 'after the beginning of the year'.
Trump said he was inclined to renew the Iran offensive if no deal is reached by the end of the year.
reported_claims.attributed_to: Donald Trump (as reported by The Times of Israel)

records.impact_assessment: Potential: renewed large-scale strikes in early 2027 and further attacks on Gulf states and shipping.
records.priority_rationale: MODERATE: an official statement of intent that changes the risk timeline; not itself an escalation.
monitoring_actions: Watch US force posture in the Gulf

sources.title: Trump says he will look to next year before deciding on Iran strikes
Nov. 22 live blog: Trump says he's inclined to renew Iran offensive if no deal reached by end of year

update_history.summary: Published after editorial review by Marcel Dera.

records.observed_action: President Trump said on 19 November he would look to the new year before deciding on renewed strikes against Iran, and on 22 November said he was inclined to renew the offensive if no deal is reached by the end of the year.
records.interpretation: A stated policy timeline rather than a decision; it raises the risk of escalation in early 2027 while indirect talks continue.
